itens.trecho: Muitos amigos indicaram Zona de Interesse. Mas um deles me alertou: "fones e volume alto!". 🎧 E não se enganem, a experiência é imersiva e perturbadora. A sonoplastia impecável te coloca dentro dos muros, onde a dicotomia entre a vida "normal" e o horror do Holocausto te prende do início ao fim. Mais que um drama, Zona de Interesse é um terror psicológico.

Some movies just have to be seen, even if they make for a difficult watch, and writer-director Jonathan Glazer’s latest is one of those pictures. While this offering is at times a bit uneven, when it’s on, it’s on, leaving a powerfully indelible mark on viewers, one that you feel in your gut and your heart and can’t get out of your mind.

WTF? Are we supposed to be watching this "slice of life" about Nazis as if they are real people and not monsters? Kudos to the mother-in-law of the commandant for having the sense to leave that hell-hole. There are way too many incredible holocaust movies to waste time on this one.
